ll.title: Learner's licence test
ll.subOnline: In {state} you can take this test online at home, with Aadhaar face check.
ll.subRto: In {state} the test is at the RTO. The screen is the same; practise it here first.
ll.tutorialWhy: Sarathi asks you to finish this tutorial within {days} days of applying, before the test.

helmet.h: Helmet and seat belt, every trip
helmet.b: A buckled ISI helmet for rider and pillion. Seat belts for everyone in a car, front and back.

speed.b: Double the speed and you need about four times the braking distance. Slow down near schools, markets and junctions.

junction.b: Give way to traffic already in the junction and to people crossing. Indicate early; check mirrors and the blind spot.

drink.h: Never drink or use your phone and drive
drink.b: Both slow your reactions. Pull over to take a call. Drink-driving is a serious offence under the Motor Vehicles Act.

ll.ready1: Sit alone in a quiet, well-lit room. Keep your face in the camera frame.
ll.ready2: The test password comes by SMS to your Aadhaar-linked mobile (simulated here).
ll.ready3: Each question has a timer. You can't go back once you move on.
ll.ready4: Nobody can take this test for you. Agents who offer to are committing fraud.
ll.passTitle: You passed the learner's licence test
ll.failLine: You can retake the test. Practise the questions you missed first.
ll.issuedSub: Download it from Sarathi in a real application. Carry it with an L-plate when you practise.
ll.name: Name
ll.qr: QR for driving schools and RTO staff to check
ll.unlockLine: The rules ask for {days} days of practice with your learner's licence first. We'll plan those days with you.
ll.toTrack: See how the driving test works
ll.retakeFrom: You can retake the test from {date}. Practise the questions you missed, pay the LL retest fee, then try again.

dl.slotSub: Pick a test office, a day and a time. Earliest day is when your driving test unlocks.

dl.eveTitle: The evening before, you'll get this
dl.eveMsg: Tomorrow {time} at {office}: carry your learner's licence, original ID, your vehicle's RC, insurance and PUC, and a helmet. Reply STOP to stop reminders.
dl.atRtoLine: In real life the examiner enters the result on Sarathi and you get an SMS. Here you can record it to continue the story.

reason.balance: Lost balance or put a foot down
reason.line: Touched or crossed a track line
reason.mirror: Didn't check mirrors or blind spot
reason.stall: Stalled or rolled back on the slope

dl.trackSub: What happens on the track, in order, and what examiners watch for.
dl.trackUnknown: Your RTO's track type isn't confirmed. Most use these layouts.

tw.s1: Start with your helmet on and mirrors set. Indicate before moving off.
tw.s2: Ride the figure 8 without putting a foot down or touching the lines.
tw.s3: Keep a steady, slow speed. Look where you're going, not at your front wheel.
tw.s4: Stop at the stop line, indicate, and park. The examiner tells you the result.

lmv.s1: Seat belt on, mirrors set, indicate, and move off smoothly.
lmv.s2: Drive the S or H track forward without touching the edges.
lmv.s3: Reverse into the parking box. Use mirrors; go slowly.
lmv.s4: Stop on the slope and move off without rolling back (handbrake, then clutch).

dl.fail1: Putting a foot down or touching a line on the 8-track
dl.fail2: Not indicating or not checking mirrors
dl.fail4: Rushing: speed costs points, it never earns them
dl.retestTitle: Not this time. Here's your way back
dl.retestSub: Lots of people need a second go. You can retest from {date}.
dl.retestGap: Retest allowed {days} days after a failed test (verify at your RTO).
dl.remedial: After a failed test the rules may ask for a short course at a driving school before you reappear.
dl.issuedSub: The RTO approved your licence. It's in your DigiLocker, and the card is on its way by post.
dl.inDigilockerLine: Driving licence {number}. Valid as a document under the IT Act when shown from DigiLocker or mParivahan.
dl.done: You did it, without an agent
dl.doneLine: From plan to licence: every step, fee and date was shown before you needed it.

school.title: Driving schools: do you need one?
school.sub: Not for a private two-wheeler or car licence. You can learn on your learner's licence with a licensed driver beside you. A school matters in these cases:
school.notCompulsory: Not compulsory for a private scooter, motorcycle or car (MCWOG, MCWG, LMV).

transport.b: Taxi, auto, truck or bus classes need a training certificate from a recognised driving school.

adtc.b: Finishing a course at an accredited centre can replace the RTO driving test. You still need the learner's licence first.

remedial.b: The rules may ask for a short remedial course at a school before you retest.

vehicle.b: A school near the RTO can lend a vehicle of your class with its papers.
